models.name: First Touch
models.description: Assigns 100% of verified closed order revenue credit to the contact's earliest eligible marketing touchpoint within the conversion window.

models.name: Last Touch
models.description: Assigns 100% of verified closed order revenue credit to the final pre-conversion marketing touchpoint before order close.
Distributes closed order revenue equally across every eligible pre-conversion touchpoint along the buyer journey.
Applies an exponential 7-day half-life decay so touchpoints closer to the conversion timestamp receive higher credit.
U-shaped allocation assigning 40% to First Touch, 40% to Last Touch, and splitting the remaining 20% evenly across middle touchpoints.
